subject.title: feat: Let users steer running ACP/sub-agent sessions from Discord (and other chat surfaces)

question: Should normal same-session Discord and bound-thread messages be allowed to reach active-run queue policy by default while another reply operation is active, or should mid-run steering stay limited to explicit command/control paths?
rationale: This changes channel/session admission semantics, not just a local runtime predicate, and it affects message delivery and session-state ordering across active turns.

options.title: Adopt a coordinated admission fix
options.body: Rebase or replace the open candidate so same-session visible turns reach queue policy without weakening cross-thread isolation.

options.title: Limit to explicit steering commands
options.body: Keep ordinary messages serialized and document that users must use explicit steer/control commands for mid-run corrections.

options.title: Defer as product work
options.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer chooses the broader chat-surface steering policy and validation bar.

recommendation.title: Adopt a coordinated admission fix
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the open candidate so same-session visible turns reach queue policy without weakening cross-thread isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the partial runtime-layer steering fix and are best positioned from the available history to decide whether to broaden the admission-layer behavior.
